programme.title: S01 : E01 A Generous Meal - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from an award-winning cookbook: A Generous Meal by his culinary school classmate, Christine Flynn! Follow along as Shahir makes craveable pumpkin stuffed shells, a juicy porkchop with fennel slaw, a refreshing peach and corn salad, and much more!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Eat Alberta First - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Eat Alberta First by Karen Anderson! Follow along as Shahir prepares lamb shanks with saskatoon berries, lip smacking good ribs, fish in mushroom cream sauce, and much more!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Upside Down - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Last things are first for this 'Upside Down' themed One Big Recipe featuring Montreal chef Kimberly Lallouz. Fruit and cheese to start? Why not? Check out her dessert wine poached Grilled Pears and Blue Cheese Salad. Next, Beef Tartare Sliders are spiked with horseradish aioli and served on warm brioche. Pasta follows, but in keeping with her topsy turvy theme, Korean flavour meets Italian savour in her Kimchi Pappardelle. Fish is next, Loup de Mer en Papillote with Ã‰crasé Potatoes is dressed up with shaved fennel and rich beurre rouge sauce. How do you end an inside-outside- upside-downside dinner? With the perfect starter! Check out Kim's Oyster Shooters with Champagne Granité for a perfect final note...

programme.title: S03 : E03 Gwyneth Paltrow Part 1 - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Gwyneth Paltrow’s cookbook The Clean Plate: Eat, Reset, Heal! Follow along as Shahir makes a za’atar chicken bowl, kale and sweet potato salad with chickpea miso, and fish tacos on jicama “tortillas!”

programme.title: S01 : E03 Abruzzo - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The secluded region of Abruzzo makes for unique Italian cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us diverse regional recipes like Rolled Meat Crepes.

programme.title: S01 : E20 Surf and Turf Connoisseurs - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: The best of land and sea come together in dishes that balance richness and elegance. Juicy steak, fresh seafood, and butter-slicked sauces sizzle side by side on the griddle, blending indulgence and artistry to reimagine a timeless culinary pairing.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Cheesy BBQ - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy Mascarpone and perfectly balances sweet, smoky, and salty flavours.

programme.title: S01 : E13 Pork was Made for Barbeques - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Pork and the grill are good buddies and host Spencer Watts shows us four of his favourite pork recipes that will have you salivating.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Fruit on the ‘Q - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Fun and quirky host Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode by showing off his knife skills as he sabres a pineapple to start his instant classic; Grilled Fruit Salad. The pineapple joins a mix of bright summer fruits on the grill, then berries, spicy citrus vinaigrette and savoury feta cheese. Next up, Spencer whips up his Hawaiian Chicken recipe. Spiced with cayenne and Chinese five spice, Spencer stuffs flavourful chicken thighs with pineapple and grills it with a delightful ginger and soy sauce. Every bite is sweet, savoury, and fresh - exactly how summer should taste! Then Spencer shares his top tips for adding smoky flavours to pork using an easy and handy smoke pouch. His Apple Smoked Pork Tenderloin is bathed in a fog of applewood smoke and he then tops it with tart apple-blueberry compote. Cinnamon buns are amazing with a bit of orange peel - but have you ever had them in an orange peel and on the grill? That's right and Spencer shows you how you can make fun and flavourful Orange Peel Cinnamon Buns on the barbecue using indirect heat.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Korea, Russia, Spain, El Salvador - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by South Korea - Jicama Kimchi, Russia - Roasted Eggplant Salad, Spain - Quinoa Paella, and El Salvador - Salvadorian Grilled Iceberg Lettuce Wedge!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Indonesia, Greece, Syria, Thailand - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Indonesia - Tomato Nasi Goreng, Greece - Greek Melon Salad, Syria - Kidney Bean Hummus, and Thailand - Coconut Curry Cabbage Rolls!

programme.title: S01 : E07 Sweden, Mexico, Senegal, Italy - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Sweden - Swedish Turnips and Granola, Mexico - Radicchio Tacos, Senegal - Cashew-Sweeth Potato Maafe, and Italy - Bok Choy Fusili!

programme.title: S01 : E08 South Africa, Iceland, Bangladesh, Spain - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by South Africa - Braaied Rapini, Iceland - Cold Icelandic Pepper Soup, Bangladesh - Edamame Jhalmuri, and Spain - Spanish Broccoli Tortilla!

programme.title: S01 : E09 France + Vietnam - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates is television's best travel show that never leaves the kitchen. Skilled Chef Craig Wong is your host, and prepare to be blown away by his takes on the foods of France and Vietnam. First up? A re-write of a popular Vietnamese street snack made with Clams and Sesame Rice Noodles. Next? Marrow Toast dresses up in its tux and tails for a version made with King Oyster Mushrooms and Sauce Bordelaise. The common ingredient is Baguette; check out supersonic versions of French Jambon Beurre and Vietnamese Banh Mi. The Big Dish blends delicate sole with ProvencÌ§ale flavour spiked Nuoc Cham and a crunchy Haricot Amandine inspired Vietnamese crepe.

programme.title: S01 : E10 USA + India - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: S02 : E11 Savory Duck & Refreshing Bites - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: From smoky mains to fresh summer bites, Maddie and Kiki prove the BBQ is about more than just grilling meat! They whip up tuna bruschetta, pair rich balsamic cherry duck with sweet seasonal flavours, and cool things down with a roasted red pepper gazpacho.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Tandoori Treats & Tangy Tenderloin - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are mixing bold marinades and fresh summer flavours for another unforgettable BBQ feast! They grill stout-marinated pork tenderloin with a tangy buttermilk potato salad, turn sweet cantaloupe into a smoky side, and spice things up with tandoori cauliflower.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Tart - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts makes tastebuds dance as he creates recipes that combine sour and tart flavours with grouper and clams.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Coffee, Tea - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Caffeine isn't just to get you going in the morning. Chef Spencer Watts shows how tea and coffee can add a lot of flavour to tuna and mussels.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Beef-a-palooza - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Grilling expert Spencer Watts hosts a tasty beef-a-palooza with four incredible beef cuts including smoked brisket and succulent beef tenderloin.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Most Liked, Most Delicious - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: From family favorites to personal go-tos, griddled dishes earn their praise bite after bite. The most liked recipes are what people request again and again, proving the most delicious meals keep people coming back for more.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Cheesy BBQ - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy Mascarpone and perfectly balances sweet, smoky, and salty flavours.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Wine - The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on wine sauces! First up, a classic veal marsala! Next, a white wine chicken gravy and a port sabayon with grapes!

programme.title: S01 : E01 A Generous Meal - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from an award-winning cookbook: A Generous Meal by his culinary school classmate, Christine Flynn! Follow along as Shahir makes craveable pumpkin stuffed shells, a juicy porkchop with fennel slaw, a refreshing peach and corn salad, and much more!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Eat Alberta First - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Eat Alberta First by Karen Anderson! Follow along as Shahir prepares lamb shanks with saskatoon berries, lip smacking good ribs, fish in mushroom cream sauce, and much more!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Upside Down - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Last things are first for this 'Upside Down' themed One Big Recipe featuring Montreal chef Kimberly Lallouz. Fruit and cheese to start? Why not? Check out her dessert wine poached Grilled Pears and Blue Cheese Salad. Next, Beef Tartare Sliders are spiked with horseradish aioli and served on warm brioche. Pasta follows, but in keeping with her topsy turvy theme, Korean flavour meets Italian savour in her Kimchi Pappardelle. Fish is next, Loup de Mer en Papillote with Ã‰crasé Potatoes is dressed up with shaved fennel and rich beurre rouge sauce. How do you end an inside-outside- upside-downside dinner? With the perfect starter! Check out Kim's Oyster Shooters with Champagne Granité for a perfect final note...

programme.title: S01 : E04 Surf and Turf - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. We all deserve a creamy cheesy break (right?), so of course Risotto Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta and Enoki Mushrooms follows. Braised Veal Osso Bucco is the big deal main course, all shored up surfingly with scrumptious Seared Scallops and smoky Grilled Broccoli Rabe!

programme.title: S01 : E20 Surf and Turf Connoisseurs - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: The best of land and sea come together in dishes that balance richness and elegance. Juicy steak, fresh seafood, and butter-slicked sauces sizzle side by side on the griddle, blending indulgence and artistry to reimagine a timeless culinary pairing.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Most Liked, Most Delicious - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: From family favorites to personal go-tos, griddled dishes earn their praise bite after bite. The most liked recipes are what people request again and again, proving the most delicious meals keep people coming back for more.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Savory Duck & Refreshing Bites - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: From smoky mains to fresh summer bites, Maddie and Kiki prove the BBQ is about more than just grilling meat! They whip up tuna bruschetta, pair rich balsamic cherry duck with sweet seasonal flavours, and cool things down with a roasted red pepper gazpacho.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Tandoori Treats & Tangy Tenderloin - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are mixing bold marinades and fresh summer flavours for another unforgettable BBQ feast! They grill stout-marinated pork tenderloin with a tangy buttermilk potato salad, turn sweet cantaloupe into a smoky side, and spice things up with tandoori cauliflower.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Veggies with V - Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a vegetable-forward menu with a table to match! There's lentils and mushrooms, watermelon salad, a farro and squash wellington, Eton mess, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E12 Mezze Marathon - Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a Mediterranean mezze-themed menu with a table to match! There's kofta, hummus, tabbouleh, fattoush, muhammara, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E01 France, Japan, Morocco, Mexico - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by France - French Fennel Soup, Japan - Unagi-Style Soy Glazed Figs, Morocco - Moroccan Butterbean Tagine, and Mexico - Asparagus Ceviche!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Thailand, France, Sweden, Italy - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Thailand - Carrot Pad Thai, France - Ground Cherry Salad, Sweden - Swedish Pecan Balls, and Italy - Corn Farroto!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Vietnam, Lebanon, China, Germany - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Vietnam - Vietnamese Green Beans, Lebanon - Watermelon Tabbouleh, China - Signapore-Style Spaghetti Squash Noodles, and Germany - Celeriac Sauerbraten and Slaw!

programme.title: S01 : E04 Italy, Morocco, Ethiopia, Jamaica - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Italy - Roasted Radishes and Radish Pesto, Morocco - Moroccan Spiced Apples, Ethiopia - Ethiopian Spinach Dip, and Jamaica - Jerk Shiitakes with Coconut Rice!

programme.title: S01 : E05 Georgia + Hong Kong - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join Bianca Osbourne to taste and combine! Fun CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne starts this episode with an inspired tribute to Georgian cuisine; Beef Tartare with Tkemali (sour plum sauce), marigold powder, and tart, crunchy pickles. Next; feast your eyes on her unique Hong Kong dumpling: plump scallops, pork, and veggies are blended, rolled, steamed, sliced, and then served with Crispy Yu Choy and XO. The common ingredient is rabbit! Georgia offers up Rabbit 'Mtsvadi', grilled and glazed with pomegranate reduction. Hong Kong represents with Sweet and Sour Rabbit, Grilled Pineapple and Red Pepper Coulis. Finally, Georgian Milk Braised meets Chinese/Hong Kong-style Roast Duck with quail egg and cheese stuffed 'Khachapuri Dumpling' and crunchy 'Peking Duck Crumble', and it's a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: S01 : E06 South Korea + Spain - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne is always looking for the best food in the world to share. The first stop is South Korea with her Sesame Crusted Tuna 'Yukhoe', a delicious blend of favourite Korean flavours. Next stamp on the passport? Spain! Mouth-watering Duck Breast is seared and served rare with a crispy artichoke heart, membrillo, olives, and sweet-savoury sherry reduction. Beef short ribs are the common ingredient with Catalonian Braised and Romesco to one side and sticky Korean Kalbi-style grilled to the east! For the topper, drool over Bulgogi Octopus simmered and served with saffron-scented Sticky Rice Paella cakes, finished with crispy Paprika-Gochujang battered mussel. Yep, it tastes as good as it sounds!

programme.title: S01 : E07 Ethiopia + Brazil - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Travel the world without ever leaving the kitchen! Intrepid host of CombiNATION Plates, Bianca Osbourne, starts this episode with Ethiopian inspired Berbere Spiced Quail, seared in aromatic Niter Kibbeh, and served with crunchy-sour Gomen Salad. Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Morocco + Thailand - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.title: S02 : E04 Tuscany - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Veneto - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: S03 : E03 Gwyneth Paltrow Part 1 - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Gwyneth Paltrow’s cookbook The Clean Plate: Eat, Reset, Heal! Follow along as Shahir makes a za’atar chicken bowl, kale and sweet potato salad with chickpea miso, and fish tacos on jicama “tortillas!”

programme.title: S01 : E03 Abruzzo - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The secluded region of Abruzzo makes for unique Italian cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us diverse regional recipes like Rolled Meat Crepes.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Savory Duck & Refreshing Bites - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: From smoky mains to fresh summer bites, Maddie and Kiki prove the BBQ is about more than just grilling meat! They whip up tuna bruschetta, pair rich balsamic cherry duck with sweet seasonal flavours, and cool things down with a roasted red pepper gazpacho.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Make Mine Mediterranean - Everyday Excellent
programme.desc: With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a Mediterranean-inspired meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: salmon with cherry tomatoes and capers, chickpea salad, lemon garlic rostis, and a peach dessert!

programme.title: S01 : E05 Weekday Rush - Everyday Excellent
programme.desc: With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a quick weekday meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: zucchini with balsamic and goat cheese, a rotini bake, and microwave lemon mug cakes!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Make Your Own Pizza Night - Everyday Excellent
programme.desc: With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a pizza night dinner for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: parm crusted chicken cutlets, roasted fennel, and broken cannoli

programme.desc: Vanessa plans a cajun-themed menu with a table to match! There's chili-garlic-cilantro shrimp, fajita rice, cornbread, tomato salad, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Winter Feast - Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a winter-themed menu with a table to match! There's cheddar biscuits, a detox kale salad, roast beef au jus, root vegetable mash, and so much more!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Sailors Bon Voyage - Road Grill
programme.desc: In between hoisting sails and scrubbing the deck, Matt and his team prepare a feast for the sailors before going on a long voyage. Not only is the weather perfect for sailing, it's perfect for BBQing! The menu: Scallop Corn Bacon Burger, Maple-apple Brined Pork Chops, Grilled Tuna Bruschetta, and Strawberry Marscapone Trifle.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Teddy Bear Picnic - Road Grill
programme.desc: Teddy Bears of all age, shape, and size join our grill team with their owners for a day of games, rides and some teddy bear repair. Matt & the RG team are BBQing a menu even the pickiest eater will love. The menu: Grilled Almond Butter & Banana Sandwiches, Grilled Meatball Sub, Smoked White Cheddar Macaroni, and Quick & Snappy Ginger Lemon Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Animal Care Fundraiser - Road Grill
programme.desc: Llamas, horses, and pigs...Oh My! The RG team lends it support to a farm animal rescue. Matt sets up his grills during a weekend fundraiser and stays friendly to his animal buddies by serving up a vegetarian menu. The menu: Portobello Burger Stack, Smoked Corn Tamale with Goat Cheese& Salsa Fresca, Pizza Salad Sandwich, and Tabbouleh Salad

programme.title: S02 : E10 Day at the Pool - Road Grill
programme.desc: The neighbourhood outdoor pool is a great way to cool down on a hot summer day. Matt and the Grill Team are dipping their feet in the pool, splashing with the kids, and, of course, grilling up some fabulous eats to munch on while playing in the park or relaxing on your towel. The menu: BBQ'd Pork Tenderloin & Pears on Bagels, Grilled Asian Chicken Burger, Surf & Turf Kabobs with Arugula Pesto, and BBQ'd Cinnamon Donuts.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Chef's Graduation - Road Grill
programme.desc: It's graduation day at Chef School and Matt and the Grill team are sharing in the festivities. To congratulate the new Chefs, Matt has cooked up a masterful menu of fancy, yet simple, dishes. The menu: Mixed Seafood Grill on a Plank, Maple Rosemary Rotisserie Chicken, Dunked Hunan Lamb Rack, and Salmon Pastrami.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Picnic Maze Craze - Road Grill
programme.desc: The Road Grill team goes rural and gets lost in hedge mazes at Saunders Farm. Luckily, they find their way out in time to cook up some BBQ and feed all families at the farm. The menu: Grilled Chicken Legs with Crunchy Chip Crust, Smoked Ham with Maple Mustard Glaze, Planked Asparagus Bundles with Cheese and Prosciutto, and Cobb Salad.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Equestrian School - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Road Grill Team get in the saddle and get inspired to grill up some BBQ! With a full school of riders to feed they grill up some Wild West plates. The menu: Texas Rockets, Perfect Beef Jerky, Beef Brisket, and Hearty Beet & fennel Salad.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Little League Soccer - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt Dunigan hits the soccer field at a local youth soccer tournament. After some fancy footwork he leaves the field and hits the grill to cook up some Slo-Smoked Saucy Ribs, some Cheesy Bacon Potato Skins, and Chicken on a stick with Home Made Plum Sauce

programme.title: S01 : E02 The Country Fair - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Road Grill Team BBQ into the night at a small town country fair. Lamb Souvlaki pita with a Tzatziki Sauce, Slo-Smoked Brisket, Bacon Wrapped Grilled Corn and Caramel Kettle Corn are serious competition for the midway.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Beach Party - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and his BBQ team hit the soft sand under the hot summer sun and treat the beach lovers to some great food that can be eaten on the go - Blackened Scallops with Avocado Salsa, Slo-Smoked Beef Ribs, Flank Steak Fajitas, and Watermelon Salad.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Ball Hockey - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt, Karrie, Jenna and Charlotte are 'Team Road Grill' at a fundraiser ball hockey tournament. They fire it up and serve the players Grilled Lamb Chops with Mint Pesto sauce, Slap shot Smoked Chicken, Power Play Crab cakes, and a Pear and Fennel Salad.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Skydiving - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Team "drop in" on a group of thrill seeking skydivers at a Skydiving Jamboree. They let the BBQs rip and grill up three different kinds of wings - smoked, jerked and 'suicide hot'. Then they cool things down with an asparagus cucumber salad.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Go Karting - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Road Grill Team put the pedal to the metal at the Go Kart Track. They crank up the heat on the grills and pull out all the stops making Summertime Pizza, Sticky BBQ Chicken, Smoked Turkey Pastrami Sandwiches and a Summer Mellon Ball Salad.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Downtown Market - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Team to cook up a midsummer feast. Leg of Lamb with Summer Herbs, Rosemary Grilled Pork Tenderloin with Wild Berry Sauce, Grilled Trout with Peaches, and a Tomato Salad have the locals raiding the market to stay stocked on the season's best.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Water Park - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Road Grill Team spend the day playing around the Water Park. The Spit Roasted Lemon-Lime Butter Chicken, Grilled Swordfish Skewers with Caribbean Salsa, and Smokey Spareribs with BBQ Sauce result in a big splash with this pool loving crowd.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Ultimate Tournament - Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Road Grill team grill up a feast for some hungry athletes at the Ultimate Frisbee Tournament. Jumbo shrimp with a rosemary dry rub, Slo-smoked Pork Butt in a Papaya Marinade, and Asian Pasta Salad have the athletes asking for more.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Beef-a-palooza - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Grilling expert Spencer Watts hosts a tasty beef-a-palooza with four incredible beef cuts including smoked brisket and succulent beef tenderloin.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Barbeque isn’t Just for Meat - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Barbeque is not just about meat! Chef Spencer Watts shows us how to grill fruits and vegetables like a pro.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Grilled, Roasted & Charred Chicken - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Charismatic host Spencer Watts shows us why chicken is best on the grill with four irresistible chicken recipes.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Lamb Four Ways - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: There are limitless options with lamb on the grill! Host Spencer Watts offers some tips and tricks on how to prepare four different cuts of lamb.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Fowl Play - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Whether for a small family dinner or a big backyard barbeque, host Spencer Watts shows us the best ways to grill up tasty duck, turkey, capon, and quail.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Sides & Sweets with Heat - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of a good side or dessert! Fun host Spencer Watts grills up the perfect sides and treats for your next barbeque.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Fruit on the ‘Q - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Fun and quirky host Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode by showing off his knife skills as he sabres a pineapple to start his instant classic; Grilled Fruit Salad. The pineapple joins a mix of bright summer fruits on the grill, then berries, spicy citrus vinaigrette and savoury feta cheese. Next up, Spencer whips up his Hawaiian Chicken recipe. Spiced with cayenne and Chinese five spice, Spencer stuffs flavourful chicken thighs with pineapple and grills it with a delightful ginger and soy sauce. Every bite is sweet, savoury, and fresh - exactly how summer should taste! Then Spencer shares his top tips for adding smoky flavours to pork using an easy and handy smoke pouch. His Apple Smoked Pork Tenderloin is bathed in a fog of applewood smoke and he then tops it with tart apple-blueberry compote. Cinnamon buns are amazing with a bit of orange peel - but have you ever had them in an orange peel and on the grill? That's right and Spencer shows you how you can make fun and flavourful Orange Peel Cinnamon Buns on the barbecue using indirect heat.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Allium in the Family - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Onions, green onions, chives, garlic, and leeks are all members of the same fabulous flowering family, Allium! First up? Chef Watts shows us his sweet and smoky Charred Leeks with Romesco; add grilled toast and you have your next party appetizer! Next up is a main course. Spencer starts with a juicy grilled pork chop, then adds roasted garlic melted into a balsamic onion chutney to make his out-of-this-world Roasted Garlic Pork Chops. Looking for a crowd pleaser that's easy to make? Spencer has a recipe for that! Chicken Yakitori. He threads skewers with crunchy green onions and tender chicken and caramelizes the yakitori sauce as he grills this tasty dish. Are you ready to drool? Spencer shows us how to make Allium your main dish with Stuffed Vidalia Onions. Loaded with savoury bacon, salty blue cheese and garlic, you'll want to eat this dish for every meal!

programme.title: S02 : E03 Cheesy BBQ - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy Mascarpone and perfectly balances sweet, smoky, and salty flavours.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Achin' for Bacon - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Grilled Veggies - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: This episode kicks off with Spencer's tasty Grilled Caesar Salad. He skillfully piles of char-grilled romaine lettuce wedges and sourdough croutons are topped with tangy dressing, crispy pancetta, and shards of a homemade parmesan tuile. For his next recipe, Spencer whips up Grilled Zucchini Boats that filled with fresh ingredients including orzo pasta, summer veggies, and herbs. Chef Watts loves a good steak and his Grilled Cauliflower Steak is not one to be passed up! Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and stretchy-melty cheese, and finishes this delicious dish on the grill.

programme.title: S02 : E06 Handheld Party Foods - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: The most liked post on any grill-master's social feed is 'meat on a stick' - and Chef Spencer's Turkish-style chicken kabob is worth every click! He marinates thick juicy chicken morsels in yogurt and spices, and then grills these flavourful skewers to a charry perfection. Next up is the creative 'Tornado Potato' which re- invents grilled potatoes with a wild presentation and a trio of toppings. Spencer then assembles Char Siu Sliders on tiny party- ready buns. Stuffed with a soy, honey and umami-packed hoisin lacquered slow-and-low grilled pork belly, these tasty little sliders will have your taste buds tingling. For his final recipe, Spencer whips up toasted crispy roti cups; topping them with plump and majestic grilled prawns and stuffed with a layered spicy chickpea curry. Now that's a BBQ party!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Fire & Spice - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies and a blend of fresh hot peppers.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Spanish Flare - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: S02 : E09 The Butter Did It - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: S02 : E10 Salt Rocks! - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: We've all cooked with salt. But what about ON salt. That's right, chef Spencer Watts blows our minds with his seared scallops that are cooked on a Himalayan pink salt block. His next recipe uses a quick cure with Hawaiian black lava salt on swordfish steaks, then tops them with a gorgeous and refreshing grilled fruit salsa. Then, Spencer gets creative with Cured Duck Legs with Scallions, using a salt cure to intensify the flavours of duck leg before it's cooked slow and low, then glazed with maple and soy. After cooking on salt, curing with salt, the only thing left is to cook INSIDE salt - Spencer's Salt Crusted Prime Rib is a game changer, flavourful, bone-in beef that he seasons with a big, bold Dijon mustard, rosemary and horseradish rub before encasing it completely in a classic salt crust and sending it to the grill.

programme.title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation

This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.desc: Accompany, contain, support: three key concepts defining Italy's iconic culinary creations—bread, cakes, and pizza. Bread, a fundamental staple, complements dishes while holding symbolic meaning. Savory pies, rooted in medieval tradition, have remained unchanged through centuries. Lastly, pizza, an ancient grain-based dish, achieved global fame after merging with tomatoes in Naples. Massimo Montanari leads us through this rich and flavorful journey.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Four Seasons 1, Maldivas - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Desde descansar en hamacas en la playa hasta tomar bebidas en un yate privado, Kim se da cuenta de que Maldivas es el destino perfecto para relajarse con estilo.

programme.desc: Desde pollo con brotes de bambú hasta un plato de tallo de plátano llamado Posola Musar Ali Khan, Alex aprende a preparar algunos platos populares de Assam.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora República Checa Karlovy Vary - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Cuenta la leyenda que Karlovy Vary fue fundada por el rey checo y emperador romano Carlos IV, quien una tarde descubrió aquí un manantial único mientras cazaba ciervos. Esta histórica ciudad balneario de la República Checa es conocida por el poder curativo de sus aguas termales. Rohan explora algunos de ellos, incluidos Freedom y Rusalka Springs, y comprende su importancia para la ciudad.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Mochila Asuán, Egipto - Backpack
programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Four Seasons 2, Maldivas - Great World Hotels

programme.title: S01 : E11 La Búsqueda Nagaland, India - Quest
programme.desc: Mientras aprende a preparar un manjar de cerdo Naga, Alex comprende los diferentes platos y estilos de cocina de las tribus de Nagaland.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Xplora República Checa Český Krumlov - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Situada a orillas del río Moldava, Český Krumlov es un buen ejemplo de ciudad medieval europea. Rohan es testigo de los elementos góticos, renacentistas y barrocos del impresionante Castillo Estatal, que domina la ciudad. También descubre la vida y obra poco convencionales del pintor de fama mundial, cuyo arte alguna vez se inspiró de manera misteriosa en esta ciudad de cuento de hadas.

programme.title: S01 : E51 Mochila Bakú, Azerbaiyán - Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici se maravilla ante las maravillas arquitectónicas de Bakú, la capital de Azerbaiyán, mientras compra recuerdos en el bazar local.

programme.desc: Desde la tradicional carne de cerdo ahumada en Nagaland hasta la carne de rana en Shillong, Alex descubre los secretos de la cocina tribal en Nagaland.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Xplora República Checa Praga - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Con un incomparable encanto del viejo mundo, Praga es la respuesta de la República Checa a París. Es considerada una de las ciudades más bellas del mundo. Rohan Patoley aprende sobre la historia y la arquitectura de esta fascinante ciudad en lugares como el majestuoso castillo de Praga, la plaza Wenceslao y un cementerio judío. Pero la mejor experiencia que tiene en Praga es cuando interactúa con el Palacio del Príncipe de Lobkowicz.

programme.title: S01 : E52 Mochila Ganja, Azerbaiyán - Backpack
programme.desc: Azerbaiyán tiene muchas maravillas naturales que podrían sorprender a un viajero. Desde volcanes de lodo físicos hasta impresionantes formaciones rocosas, Sabrina Chakici es testigo de algunos de ellos en el Parque Nacional de Gobustán. Después de esto, llega a la ciudad de Ganja, donde descubre la historia en lugares espectaculares como el Parque Heyder Aliyev, el Mausoleo Imamzadeh, la Mezquita Juma y el Mausoleo Nizami.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Spas del Mundo Fusión Maia, Vietnam - World Spas
programme.desc: Natural Living Massage, uno de los tratamientos exclusivos del complejo spa todo incluido Fusion Maia en Da Nang, Vietnam, es una combinación de curación oriental y aromaterapia. Jamie Srubis prueba esto junto con otros tratamientos como un masaje linfático tibio con bambú, que es bueno para desintoxicar, y Mindful Energy, un tratamiento de spa que combina reiki con una sesión de masaje de cabeza.

programme.title: S01 : E13 La Búsqueda Shillong, India - Quest
programme.desc: Mientras cocina el pescado local de la región Jaintia de Meghalaya, Alex también se familiariza con la herencia culinaria de Sylhet en Bangladesh.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Guía XP Wayanad, India - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Wayanad, un pueblo bucólico de Kerala, ofrece un itinerario lleno de vida silvestre, ayurveda, plantaciones y spas.

programme.title: S01 : E52 Mochila Ganja, Azerbaiyán - Backpack
programme.desc: Azerbaiyán tiene muchas maravillas naturales que podrían sorprender a un viajero. Desde volcanes de lodo físicos hasta impresionantes formaciones rocosas, Sabrina Chakici es testigo de algunos de ellos en el Parque Nacional de Gobustán. Después de esto, llega a la ciudad de Ganja, donde descubre la historia en lugares espectaculares como el Parque Heyder Aliyev, el Mausoleo Imamzadeh, la Mezquita Juma y el Mausoleo Nizami.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Relajación Park Hyatt, Maldivas - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya, se relaja en un lujoso resort isleño de las Maldivas. Al estar alojada en una villa con piscina, va a avistar delfines, hacer snorkel, practicar yoga y aprender una receta de pescado, para terminar con una cena al aire libre.

programme.title: S01 : E14 La Búsqueda Calcuta 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: En Calcuta, Alex conoce a Rajiv Neogi y Siddhartha Bose, expertos gastronómicos que le presentan algunos de los platos olvidados de la cocina bengalí.

programme.title: S01 : E55 Guía XP Copenhague - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Elisha visita el parque de atracciones más antiguo del mundo: Tivoli Garden en Copenhague, que es la inspiración para Disneyland.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Espacios en la Ciudad Madrid, España - City Breaks
programme.desc: No hay mejor lugar para sentir el "duende", el espíritu y la pasión de España que su animada capital, Madrid. Alex capta algo de la contagiosa vivacidad de la ciudad en sus bulliciosas plazas como el Puerto del Sol y la Plaza Mayor. Experimenta el amor de los españoles por la comida mientras saborea auténticos churros españoles. También conoce la rica y compleja historia de la ciudad en lugares como la Catedral de la Almudena y el Palacio Real de Madrid.

programme.title: S01 : E17 Espacios en la Ciudad Múnich, Alemania - City Breaks
programme.desc: Desde palacios hasta museos, los edificios de Múnich son una mezcla fascinante de arquitectura tradicional bávara y diseño de vanguardia.

programme.title: S01 : E08 La Búsqueda Lucknow & Rewa - Quest
programme.desc: Dé un paseo por las calles de Lucknow y deléitese con una comida reconfortante y también descubra algunas recetas antiguas favoritas para compartir y conservar en este episodio de Quest.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora República Checa Kutná Hora - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: La antigua ciudad minera de plata de Kutná Hora fue la segunda ciudad más importante del Reino medieval de Bohemia después de Praga. Rohan Patoley aprende sobre las antiguas glorias de la ciudad en la antigua casa de la moneda real, la corte italiana, y se sumerge en el romance de la pintoresca bodega Vinné Sklepy. También asiste al Royal Silvering Festival, una celebración gótica anual que recuerda el rico pasado de la ciudad.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Mochila El Cairo, Egipto - Backpack
programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E27 Espacios en la Ciudad Bengaluru, India - City Breaks
programme.desc: Machen Sie eine Pause von Ihrer alltäglichen Routine und entdecken Sie, was verschiedene Städte mit City Breaks zu bieten haben.

programme.title: S01 : E09 La Búsqueda Rewa, India - Quest
programme.desc: Ya sean recetas que evolucionaron a partir de la caza o platos que se prepararon como ofrendas a Dios, Alex descubre los secretos de la cocina real de Bagheli.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora República Checa Pilsen - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Pilsen se jacta de tener una majestuosa plaza barroca y magníficas iglesias góticas, pero el mundo siempre será conocida como el lugar de nacimiento de la primera y posiblemente mejor cerveza lager del mundo, Pilsner Urquell. Rohan Patoley realiza un recorrido por la cervecería más famosa de la ciudad que practica el arte de elaborar cerveza desde hace más de 700 años.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Mochila Alejandría, Egipto - Backpack
programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Four Seasons 1, Maldivas - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Desde descansar en hamacas en la playa hasta tomar bebidas en un yate privado, Kim se da cuenta de que Maldivas es el destino perfecto para relajarse con estilo.

programme.title: S01 : E10 La Búsqueda Jorhat, India - Quest
programme.desc: Desde pollo con brotes de bambú hasta un plato de tallo de plátano llamado Posola Musar Ali Khan, Alex aprende a preparar algunos platos populares de Assam.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora República Checa Karlovy Vary - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Cuenta la leyenda que Karlovy Vary fue fundada por el rey checo y emperador romano Carlos IV, quien una tarde descubrió aquí un manantial único mientras cazaba ciervos. Esta histórica ciudad balneario de la República Checa es conocida por el poder curativo de sus aguas termales. Rohan explora algunos de ellos, incluidos Freedom y Rusalka Springs, y comprende su importancia para la ciudad.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Mochila Asuán, Egipto - Backpack
programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Four Seasons 2, Maldivas - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un vigorizante tratamiento de spa, una lección de cocina, una sesión de snorkel: Kim tiene experiencias en las Maldivas que la dejan completamente rejuvenecida.

programme.title: S01 : E11 La Búsqueda Nagaland, India - Quest
programme.desc: Mientras aprende a preparar un manjar de cerdo Naga, Alex comprende los diferentes platos y estilos de cocina de las tribus de Nagaland.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Xplora República Checa Český Krumlov - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Situada a orillas del río Moldava, Český Krumlov es un buen ejemplo de ciudad medieval europea. Rohan es testigo de los elementos góticos, renacentistas y barrocos del impresionante Castillo Estatal, que domina la ciudad. También descubre la vida y obra poco convencionales del pintor de fama mundial, cuyo arte alguna vez se inspiró de manera misteriosa en esta ciudad de cuento de hadas.

programme.title: S01 : E51 Mochila Bakú, Azerbaiyán - Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici se maravilla ante las maravillas arquitectónicas de Bakú, la capital de Azerbaiyán, mientras compra recuerdos en el bazar local.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora República Checa Pilsen - Xplore Czech Republic

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Omán Muscat - Xplore Oman
programme.desc: En una visita a Mascate, la capital de Omán, Elisha Kriis se encuentra boquiabierta ante la magnificencia de la Gran Mezquita del Sultán Qaboos, que domina el horizonte de la ciudad. Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.

programme.title: S01 : E01 10 Días En Corea Seoul - 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: Seúl, la capital de Corea del Sur, es una ciudad dinámica que forja sin miedo un camino hacia el futuro preservando fielmente sus raíces. Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Omán Muscat - Xplore Oman
programme.desc: En una visita a Mascate, la capital de Omán, Elisha Kriis se encuentra boquiabierta ante la magnificencia de la Gran Mezquita del Sultán Qaboos, que domina el horizonte de la ciudad. Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.

Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Omán Muscat - Xplore Oman
programme.desc: En una visita a Mascate, la capital de Omán, Elisha Kriis se encuentra boquiabierta ante la magnificencia de la Gran Mezquita del Sultán Qaboos, que domina el horizonte de la ciudad. Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.

programme.title: S01 : E01 10 Días En Corea Seoul - 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: Seúl, la capital de Corea del Sur, es una ciudad dinámica que forja sin miedo un camino hacia el futuro preservando fielmente sus raíces. Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.
